The structure of ErAlSi₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms—4 Er, 4 Al, and 8 Si—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Al centers with 14 geometric neighbors (4 Al, 10 Si), Er centers with 8 Si neighbors, and two distinct Si environments with 10 and 11 neighbors, respectively. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and face sharing between Al and Si 11-vertex polyhedra, and between Al and Si 10-vertex polyhedra.
